scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@ayd/shared && npm run build --workspace=@ayd/ssrf-guard && npm run build --workspace=@ayd/crypto && npm run build --workspace=@ayd/sql-guard && npm run build --workspace=@ayd/database && npm run build --workspace=@ayd/core && npm run build --workspace=@ayd/api && npm run build --workspace=@ayd/worker && npm run build --workspace=@ayd/web
